_readme: Materials for the stills module (tools/talk/modules/stills.py, tools/blender/stills.py, venus_poly.py). Merged into talk_materials.json's set by tools/blender/common.py and SphererebroTalk.cs; delete this file with the module. The pictures are unlit (Ben's own images, talk/gen/still_*.png from tools/geo/stills_art.py); the Venus figure is lit by the module's two lights, with a little glow of its own so it is never black.
